subject: 16 Foster Court Demolition Determination
overview: The Commission reviewed the historical preservation status of 16 Foster Court and 20 Otis Street, voting to release both from demolition delay. Members also discussed potential updates to the city ordinance to clarify procedural ambiguities during property ownership transitions.

items.title: 16 Foster Court Demolition Review
items.summary: Voted to find the early 19th-century structure not preferably preserved, concluding that further preservation efforts were unlikely to succeed given a previous lack of City Council support for a local historic district.

items.title: 20 Otis Street Carriage House Design
items.summary: Released the property from demolition delay after the owners modified their architectural plans to include historical details like corner boards and trim that better recall the original carriage house.

items.title: Ordinance Revision Discussion
items.summary: Commissioners and city legal staff discussed drafting amendments to the demolition delay ordinance to clarify procedures and avoid legal "gray areas" when properties change ownership during the review process.
